streaming_input.text: Being in an offside position is not automatically a foul. Your position is judged
when a teammate plays or touches the ball, and you're only penalized if
you then become involved in the play.
On a clear, flat area, spend one minute each on easy jogging, controlled
lateral steps, alternating knee lifts and heel-to-butt movements, then shallow squ
ats and reverse lunges. Finish with three 15-second progressive runs and
5-second walking resets. You need no equipment. Stay comfortable, never sprint
all-out, and stop for sharp pain, dizziness, chest pain, or
